admission: distinct event identity within and across arm partitions
arm_scope.rule: Each arm retains its real venue, decoder, evaluator, policy slot, and evidence partition. No ARM07 result is reused as ARM08 or another arm evidence.

causal_execution_model.entry: first usable venue-native observed state at or after signal plus one second
causal_execution_model.exit_marks: first usable same-venue state at or after the declared horizon; unavailable marks remain explicit failures/censoring
causal_execution_model.failed_or_missed: never silently removed; reported separately and included in coverage gates
causal_execution_model.fees: exact venue-native LP/protocol/creator fees when available
causal_execution_model.impact: integer venue-native quote at each candidate notional
causal_execution_model.network_and_priority_fees: not yet observed; excluded from offline results and required before execution claims

dynamic_exits.rule: exit at +100 bps ROI, otherwise at 300 seconds
exit at +200 bps ROI, otherwise at 300 seconds
arm at +100 bps ROI, exit at 0 bps, otherwise at 300 seconds
sell 50% at +100 bps, remainder at the declared time horizon
sell 50% at +200 bps, remainder at the declared time horizon

sizing_hypotheses.rule: largest notional at or below 25 bps modeled entry impact, hard capped at 1.0 SOL
largest notional at or below 50 bps modeled entry impact, hard capped at 1.0 SOL
largest notional at or below 100 bps modeled entry impact, hard capped at 1.0 SOL

discovery_selection_gate.purpose: Select a candidate for freezing without claiming validation.
requirements: positive net PnL after exact observed costs and 50 bps stress
positive mean ROI at the target notional
positive in both chronological discovery halves
no single trade contributes more than 30 percent of total PnL
missing/failed coverage is reported and below the arm-specific threshold
discovery_selection_gate.selection_rule: Choose at most one frozen candidate per arm using discovery data only; if no candidate passes, freeze nothing.

invalidation_evidence: No arm produces positive out-of-sample net economics after venue-native costs and controls.
Positive discovery results disappear under causal entry timing or modest slippage stress.
Liquidity/impact-capped sizing does not improve realistic ROI or drawdown.
hypothesis.name: venue_native_early_wallet_impulse_with_liquidity_capped_size
hypothesis.statement: A genuine early tracked-wallet purchase can identify positive short-horizon opportunity, but only after venue-native causal quoting, realistic costs, and a liquidity/impact-capped notional.
supporting_evidence: kEFi activity spans multiple venue families and the current registry preserves separate venue hypotheses.
ARM07 has a preserved historical signal, but its causal fixed-30 result is not currently profitable.
ARM07 fixed-size economics degrade materially as notional rises because of AMM impact and fees.

promotion_order: dust-size Rust-only calibration only after explicit approval
larger live sizing only after further approval
requirements: genuine venue admission certificate on every row
controls not beaten only by a single outlier
realistic size remains profitable, preferably at 0.5 SOL
